entities.summary: Aleksei Andreyevich Kolosov is a Belarusian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Lehigh Valley Phantoms of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He is the first Belarusian net-minder to ever play in the NHL, having made his debut on 27 October 2024.
